title: A servings label photo logs the whole pack by default and never asks (held-out variant of lc-photo-default)
replays: Held-out variant of lc-photo-default (fix pass F4): other numbers and other words than the playbook's worked example (servings per pouch, not bars per pack), so a pass shows the rule generalizes and is not the model copying its prompt.

steps.text: Here is a photo of the nutrition label on my trail mix pouch: 150 kcal per serving, 4 servings per pouch. Logging my snack.
